source_doc.title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q — 客戶集中度與 supply/capacity commitments（curated excerpt）

sources.quote: We refer to customers who purchase products directly from NVIDIA as direct customers, such as add-in board manufacturers, or AIBs, distributors, original design manufacturers, or ODMs, original equipment manufacturers, or OEMs, cloud service providers, or CSPs, AI model makers, and system integrators.
Five direct customers accounted for 22 %, 14 %, 13 %, 11 %, and 10 % of our accounts receivable balance as of July 26, 2026.
Supply and capacity $ 92 $ 87 $ 88 $ 6 $ 5 $ 1 $ 279 ... increasing supply commitments from $ 119 billion last quarter to $ 279 billion as of July 26, 2026.

These supply commitments are for our data center infrastructure systems, primarily memory and manufacturing facilities, to produce our products for long-term demand across current and future product architectures.

We enter into agreements with our suppliers that allow them to procure inventory based upon our defined criteria, and in certain instances, these agreements may be cancelable, rescheduled, or adjustable for our business needs prior to placing firm orders.

Revenue by geographic region is designated based on the location of the headquarters of direct customers. United States $ 60,074 ... Taiwan 26,985 ... China (including Hong Kong) 7,880 ... Total revenue $ 96,221

claims.statement: NVIDIA disclosed that supply and capacity commitments increased from $119 billion in the prior quarter to $279 billion as of 2026-07-26, with total future commitments of $366 billion across fiscal 2027 through 2032+. The issuer describes these commitments as being for data center infrastructure systems, 'primarily memory and manufacturing facilities'. The issuer does NOT name any supplier, and does not disclose the split between memory and manufacturing, so no supplier-level or component-level (HBM vs DRAM) attribution is supported by this document.
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if a subsequent NVIDIA filing discloses a material reduction in total supply and capacity commitments below the $279 billion level, or restates the fiscal-year phasing. 核查頻率：每季 10-Q/10-K；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。

claims.statement: NVIDIA's supply commitments are not uniformly firm: the issuer states that supplier agreements allow suppliers to procure inventory based on NVIDIA's defined criteria and 'in certain instances, these agreements may be cancelable, rescheduled, or adjustable for our business needs prior to placing firm orders.' The $279 billion figure therefore cannot be read as fully committed non-cancelable demand.
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if NVIDIA later discloses that substantially all such commitments have converted to firm, non-cancelable purchase orders. 核查頻率：每季 10-Q/10-K；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。
